correctness.rationale: Exact 9x9 determinant factorization verified by 3+5 ring unitary Fourier reduction and standard normalized spherical harmonics. Log-factor strict concavity, resultant -6(x−1)(x+1)(39x²−11x−14), and exact rational chamber comparison prove unique global optimum. The standalone numerical checker passed 83 supplementary tests but is not relied upon for the continuum proof.

originality.rationale: The restricted continuous-height D-optimum for a south-pole/three-ring/five-ring quadratic spherical-harmonic interpolation grid is not implied by inspected 2014/2017 fixed-equiangular or per-order conditioning papers, sphere t-design regression literature, or fully read related published single-ring and paired-ring results. Equivalent older unindexed work is a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Older unindexed Fekete, optimal regression, or special latitude interpolation literature might contain an algebraically equivalent constrained determinant optimum.
Other nine-point sampling geometries or other objectives could give different optimum; these are expressly out of scope.

value.rationale: First nontrivial L=3 optimal-dimensional 1+3+5 harmonic interpolation design admits a complete natural determinant classification including all degeneracies, a unique algebraic latitude optimum, invariance to arbitrary ring rotations, and a 12.36% information-volume gain over conventional equiangular heights. It is a motivated exact finite-dimensional invariant, not a small arbitrary slice or a claim about worst-case singular value.
